morphology.pattern_note: meN- 在词首 b 前采用 mem-，b 保留；这里表示进入某种状态。词尾 /k/ 在部分马来西亚发音中实现为 [ʔ]。

senses.zh_definition: 变得腐臭；有机物腐坏并产生难闻气味。
senses.en_definition: To become rotten or foul-smelling, especially through organic decay.
senses.nuances: DBP《Kamus Dewan Edisi Keempat》释为 menjadi busuk。不及物，主体本身发生变化：sampah membusuk。使别的东西腐臭用 membusukkan；单纯描述现有气味可用 berbau busuk。不要把 busuk 的所有比喻义自动移植到此动词。[DBP：busuk 及其派生词](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=busuk)

collocations.zh: 正在腐烂发臭的动物尸体

dual_scenarios.context: 新闻 / 环境卫生通报
dual_scenarios.ms: Sisa makanan yang membusuk di kawasan pasar itu telah menimbulkan bau yang tidak menyenangkan.
dual_scenarios.zh: 该市场内腐坏发臭的食物残渣已产生难闻气味。
dual_scenarios.en: Food waste decomposing at the market has produced an unpleasant smell.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 室友讨论厨房垃圾
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Sampah kat dapur tu dah mula membusuk lah.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Sampah di dapur itu sudah mula membusuk.
dual_scenarios.zh: 厨房那袋垃圾都开始发臭了。
dual_scenarios.en: The rubbish in the kitchen is starting to stink.
spoken_features: 句末 lah 在此加强提醒语气。
口语也常用 dah busuk 描述已经腐臭的状态；本句保留 membusuk，突出变化过程。

messages.speaker: Farah (室友)
messages.ms_spoken: Sampah kat dapur tu dah mula membusuk lah. Kau nak buang sekarang ke?
messages.ms_standard: Sampah di dapur itu sudah mula membusuk. Adakah awak mahu membuangnya sekarang?
messages.zh: 厨房那袋垃圾都开始发臭了。你现在拿去扔吗？
messages.en: The rubbish in the kitchen is starting to stink. Are you taking it out now?

messages.speaker: Amir (室友)
messages.ms_spoken: Ya, aku buang sekarang. Tolong buka pintu kejap.
messages.ms_standard: Ya, saya akan membuangnya sekarang. Tolong buka pintu sebentar.
messages.zh: 嗯，我现在就扔。帮我开一下门。
messages.en: Yes, I'll take it out now. Can you open the door for me?

etymology.historical_story: Membusuk is transparently formed within Malay from busuk and the verbal prefix meN-, which takes the form mem- here. Its useful distinction is between a condition and a developing process: busuk describes something rotten, while membusuk describes becoming rotten. DBP illustrates that process with decaying organic matter, including accumulated rubbish. [DBP dictionary](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=busuk)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: busuk 是“臭了”，membusuk 是“变臭”：想象垃圾从没有明显气味，到逐渐腐臭，就记住这个变化动词。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 用于垃圾、食物残渣等对象时直接自然。提醒别人清理时，可加 tolong 或请对方一起处理，减少责备感。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适合环境卫生、食物腐坏及有机物分解语境。直接用来形容一个人容易形成侮辱；谈逝者遗体时，应根据报道或专业需要采用尊重、客观的措辞。
